title: Move base images to public cgr.dev/chainguard/node on latest; drop digestabot and chainctl auth
context: Chainguard is moving off the private barretta org to the free tier, which cannot pin digests. The owner switched the Dockerfile to the public catalog (cgr.dev/chainguard/node:latest-dev builder, :latest runner; resolves anonymously, Node v26.10.0). The barretta.dev org path returns 403 and is NOT used. Consequences: (1) base images float on latest; (2) digestabot (update-digests.yml + octo-sts trust policy) has nothing to update and is removed; (3) public images need no registry credentials, so the setup-chainctl steps and CHAINCTL_IDENTITY use in CI/deploy are removed, which also fixes Dependabot docker-build failures. Source plans: .claude/plans/yes-git-pull-yes-adaptive-wren.md (superseded on org path). PRE-DISPATCH: the owner's Dockerfile edit is uncommitted in the working tree; commit it first (or discard it; task 1 re-applies it idempotently) because wave pre-flight needs a clean tree. OUT OF REPO (owner): after merge, delete the now-unused CHAINCTL_IDENTITY secret from both Actions and Dependabot stores; optionally uninstall the octo-sts/digestabot GitHub App; `@dependabot recreate` #151/#105/#106 and confirm docker-build passes with no chainctl step. NOTE: merging the Dockerfile change triggers the Deploy workflow (paths-ignore skips .github/** and *.md but not the Dockerfile), so the merge itself deploys the new base image to production.
verification: npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
constraints: Do not touch .npmrc or any libraries.cgr.dev reference (a host, not org-scoped)
Do not edit historical .claude/plans/* files other than this plan and its source .md
terraform/wif.tf: comment-only change; no resource, variable, or condition edits
Dockerfile: keep the native-module smoke test and the USER 65532 / /app layout unchanged
deploy.yml must keep `id-token: write` (GCP workload identity federation needs it); only the chainctl step and its comment are removed

waves.notes: Task 1 owns Dockerfile, README, GCP doc, ci.yml and deploy.yml, including the ci.yml digestabot comment.
Depends on task 1: task 2 ac6 is a repo-wide grep that must see the ci.yml comment removal from task 1 (Codex plan-review pr1). File sets are otherwise disjoint.
